description: Evidenca proizvajalcev in pooblaščenih zastopnikov proizvajalcev električne in elektronske opreme is a dataset listed in Slovenia’s open data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by MINISTRSTVO ZA OKOLJE IN PROSTOR. V evidenci so zbrani podatki o proizvajalcih električne in elektronske opreme in pooblaščenih zastopnikih proizvajalcev električne in elektronske opreme. Coverage: MINISTRSTVO ZA OKOLJE IN PROSTOR. The publisher named on the listing is MINISTRSTVO ZA OKOLJE IN PROSTOR. Its keywords include razred električne in elektronske opreme, vrsta električne in elektronske opreme, električna in elektronska oprema, prodaja na daljavo, skupni načrt. The listing shows 2 download or service links in PDF, HTML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-odprti-podatki-slovenije.
